name: Job Roster
query:
SELECT
	method                                                       AS "Job:Data:340",
	frequency                                                    AS "Freq:Data:110",
	stopped                                                      AS "Stopped:Int:80",
	last_execution                                               AS "Last run:Datetime:165",
	ROUND(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, last_execution, NOW()) / 60, 1)  AS "Hrs quiet:Float:95",
	cron_format                                                  AS "Cron:Data:130"
FROM `tabScheduled Job Type`
ORDER BY last_execution IS NULL DESC, last_execution ASC
